<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="L_CU" name="Coordination Unit">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>finalize</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>qa</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_SO" name="Support Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>calendars</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>folders</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>advise</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>minutes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>records</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_CM" name="Committee Members">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>hold</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Meetings to be scheduled" />
    <bpmn:task id="finalize" name="Finalize the dates" />
    <bpmn:task id="calendars" name="Update all group calendars" />
    <bpmn:task id="folders" name="Create meeting folders and upload documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="advise" name="Advise Committee Members to read documents" />
    <bpmn:task id="hold" name="Hold the meeting" />
    <bpmn:task id="minutes" name="Produce minutes with Action Points" />
    <bpmn:task id="qa" name="Conduct QA check on the minutes" />
    <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send minutes to all Committee Members" />
    <bpmn:task id="records" name="Update all departmental records" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Records updated" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="finalize" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="finalize" targetRef="calendars" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="calendars" targetRef="folders" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="folders" targetRef="advise" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="advise" targetRef="hold" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="hold" targetRef="minutes" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="minutes" targetRef="qa" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="qa" targetRef="send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="send" targetRef="records" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="records" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
